chapter_seo_title: Chapter 176: The World is Alive – The Terrifying Revelation that Ends Book One
chapter_meta_description: Danyangzi is erased. Li Huowang enters the White Jade Capital, sees Bashe, and returns from the grave with a final, shattering truth: the world is alive, and it is far crazier than he is. Book One ends.
og_title: Chapter 176: Mad – The Truth Breaks Reality
og_description: The finale of Book One. Danyangzi dissolves before a mountain of corpse-gods. Li Huowang sees the umbilical cords of the universe. Bashe rushes toward him. He crawls from his own grave to declare: the world is alive, and it is insane.
twitter_title: Book One Finale: The World is a Mad, Living Thing
twitter_description: Danyangzi is gone in a heartbeat. Li Huowang sees the truth behind reality... and it's screaming. He returns from his own funeral to confess: 'It's crazy. It's far crazier than I am.'
